Title: Continue
Description: The server has received the request headers and the client should proceed to send the request body.

Title: Switching Protocols
Description: The requester has asked the server to switch protocols and the server has agreed to do so.

Title: Processing
Description: The server is processing the request, but no response is available yet.

Title: Early Hints
Description: The server is likely to send a final response with the header fields provided in this message.

Title: OK
Description: The request succeeded.

Title: Created
Description: The request succeeded, and a new resource was created as a result.

Title: Accepted
Description: The request has been accepted for processing, but the processing has not been completed.

Title: Non-Authoritative Information
Description: The server is a transforming proxy that received a 200 OK from its origin, but is returning a modified version of the origin's response.

Title: No Content
Description: The server successfully processed the request and is not returning any content.

Title: Reset Content
Description: The server successfully processed the request, asking the client to reset the document view.

Title: Partial Content
Description: The server is delivering only part of the resource due to a range header sent by the client.

Title: Multi-Status
Description: The message body that follows is an XML message and can contain a number of separate response codes, depending on how many sub-requests were made.

Title: Already Reported
Description: The members of a DAV binding have already been enumerated in a preceding part of the (multistatus) response.

Title: IM Used
Description: The server has fulfilled a GET request for the resource, and the response is a representation of the result of one or more instance-manipulations applied to the current instance.

Title: Multiple Choices
Description: Indicates multiple options for the resource from which the client may choose.

Title: Moved Permanently
Description: This and all future requests should be directed to the given URI.

Title: Found
Description: The resource was found but at a different URI.

Title: See Other
Description: The response to the request can be found under another URI using a GET method.

Title: Not Modified
Description: Indicates that the resource has not been modified since the last request.

Title: Use Proxy
Description: The requested resource is available only through a proxy, the address for which is provided in the response.

Title: (Unused)
Description: This code was used in a previous version of the HTTP specification. It is no longer used, but is still reserved.

Title: Temporary Redirect
Description: The server sent this response to direct the client to get the requested resource at another URI with the same method.

Title: Permanent Redirect
Description: This and all future requests should be directed to the given URI.

Title: Bad Request
Description: The server cannot or will not process the request due to an apparent client error.

Title: Unauthorized
Description: Similar to 403 Forbidden, but specifically for use when authentication is required and has failed or has not yet been provided.

Title: Payment Required
Description: Reserved for future use.

Title: Forbidden
Description: The request was valid, but the server is refusing to respond to it.

Title: Not Found
Description: The requested resource could not be found but may be available in the future.

Title: Method Not Allowed
Description: A request method is not supported for the requested resource.

Title: Not Acceptable
Description: The requested resource is capable of generating only content not acceptable according to the Accept headers sent in the request.

Title: Proxy Authentication Required
Description: The client must first authenticate itself with the proxy.

Title: Request Timeout
Description: The server timed out waiting for the request.

Title: Conflict
Description: The request could not be completed because of a conflict with the current state of the resource.

Title: Gone
Description: The requested resource is no longer available and will not be available again.

Title: Length Required
Description: The request did not specify the length of its content, which is required by the requested resource.

Title: Precondition Failed
Description: The server does not meet one of the preconditions that the requester put on the request.

Title: Content Too Large
Description: The request entity is larger than limits defined by the server.

Title: URI Too Long
Description: The URI provided was too long for the server to process.

Title: Unsupported Media Type
Description: The request entity has a media type which the server or resource does not support.

Title: Range Not Satisfiable
Description: The client has asked for a portion of the file, but the server cannot supply that portion.

Title: Expectation Failed
Description: The server cannot meet the requirements of the Expect request-header field.

Title: I'm a Teapot
Description: The server refuses the attempt to brew coffee with a teapot.

Title: Misdirected Request
Description: The request was directed at a server that is not able to produce a response.

Title: Unprocessable Content
Description: The request was well-formed but was unable to be followed due to semantic errors.

Title: Locked
Description: The resource that is being accessed is locked.

Title: Failed Dependency
Description: The request failed due to failure of a previous request.

Title: Too Early
Description: The server is unwilling to risk processing a request that might be replayed.

Title: Upgrade Required
Description: The server refuses to perform the request using the current protocol.

Title: Precondition Required
Description: The origin server requires the request to be conditional.

Title: Too Many Requests
Description: The user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time.

Title: Request Header Fields Too Large
Description: The server is unwilling to process the request because its header fields are too large.

Title: Unavailable For Legal Reasons
Description: The user requests an illegal resource, such as a web page censored by a government.

Title: Internal Server Error
Description: A generic error message, given when an unexpected condition was encountered and no more specific message is suitable.

Title: Not Implemented
Description: The server either does not recognize the request method, or it lacks the ability to fulfill the request.

Title: Bad Gateway
Description: The server was acting as a gateway or proxy and received an invalid response from the upstream server.

Title: Service Unavailable
Description: The server is currently unavailable (because it is overloaded or down for maintenance).

Title: Gateway Timeout
Description: The server was acting as a gateway or proxy and did not receive a timely response from the upstream server.

Title: HTTP Version Not Supported
Description: The HTTP version used in the request is not supported by the server.

Title: Variant Also Negotiates
Description: The server has an internal configuration error: the chosen variant resource is configured to engage in transparent content negotiation itself.

Title: Insufficient Storage
Description: The server is unable to store the representation needed to complete the request.

Title: Loop Detected
Description: The server detected an infinite loop while processing the request.

Title: Not Extended
Description: Further extensions to the request are required for the server to fulfill it.

Title: Network Authentication Required
Description: The client needs to authenticate to gain network access.
